gloss: area under the nose; upper lip

definitions.gloss: area under the nose; upper lip
definitions.explanation: The strip of skin between the nose and the mouth, where a mustache grows. Best known from the idiom {鼻|はな}の{下|した}を{伸|の}ばす.

examples.japanese: {鼻|はな}の{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧。
⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧{鼻|はな}の{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かいた。
examples.english: It was so hot that I broke out in sweat above my upper lip.

examples.japanese: ⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけられて→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{鼻|はな}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばしていた→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧。
examples.english: When the pretty clerk spoke to him, he went completely gaga.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鼻|はな}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: (of a man) to go soft over a woman, to be smitten
- {鼻|はな}の{下|した}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: easily smitten by women

USAGE:
The idioms are teasing and informal, and are used about men.
